description: This file is a PHP source code defining a controller class for the 'account' module extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles displaying the account management page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'account' module in the OpenCart admin extension namespace, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the account module configuration page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and other layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the account module via POST request, with permission checks and JSON responses.
